content.text: Shattered World is a Crusader Kings II mod that divides the world at the county level and removes all duchies, kingdoms, and empires from the game.

It is not to be confused with the Random World feature, also known as "shattered world," which has a similar effect but is a feature available only with the DLC Holy Fury . The Shattered World mod can be played without any DLCs.
The mod enables the player to play as a count with casus belli to attack neighboring counties without the presence duchies, kingdoms, or empires.
The earliest start time offered by the mod is AD 1066.
